0.headline: Defence electronics equipment maker Tonbo Imaging IPO set to hit Dalal Street next week with pure OFS of 1.2 crore shares
0.heading: Defence electronics equipment maker Tonbo Imaging IPO set to hit Dalal Street next week with pure OFS of 1.2 crore shares
0.intro: Tonbo Imaging India IPO | Investors including CEAQ Technologies, Timothy Guy Mitchell, and Artiman Partners LLC, along with promoters Arvind Kondangi, Lakshmikumar, Ankit Kumar, and Cecilia D’Souza, will be among the selling shareholders in OFS.
0.body:
Bengaluru-based defence electronics original equipment manufacturer (OEM) Tonbo Imaging India is set to launch its initial public offering (IPO) for subscription on October 15. It will be among six companies opening their IPOs next week, alongside Zetwerk Manufacturing Business, Fusion CX, Sahajanand Medical Technologies, Bonfiglioli Transmissions, and HD Fire Protect.

The IPO comprises an offer for sale (OFS) of 1.21 crore equity shares by existing shareholders, with no fresh issue component.

Investors including CEAQ Technologies, Timothy Guy Mitchell, Artiman Partners LLC, and Ramesh Radhakrishnan, along with promoters Arvind Kondangi, Lakshmikumar, Ankit Kumar, and Cecilia D’Souza, will be among the selling shareholders in the OFS.

The company approached capital markets by filing draft document with SEBI in December 2025, which subsequently approved by the capital markets regulator in September 2026.

The anchor book for the defence-focused product manufacturer will open for one day on October 14, while the IPO will close for public subscription on October 19. The company is expected to finalise the share allotment on October 21 and list its equity shares on the stock exchanges on October 23.

As the IPO comprises entirely an OFS, the net proceeds, after accounting for applicable issue expenses and the employee reservation, will accrue to the selling shareholders. The company will not receive any proceeds from the public issue.

Click Here To Read All IPO News

Tonbo Imaging has reserved 50 percent of the net offer, excluding the employee portion, for qualified institutional buyers (QIBs), 15 percent for non-institutional investors (NIIs), and the remaining 35 percent for retail investors. In addition, up to 14,000 shares have been reserved for eligible employees, who may be offered the shares at a discount to the final offer price.

The company will announce its IPO price band on October 12.

Incorporated in 2003, Tonbo Imaging designs and manufactures electro-optic and electronic systems for defence applications. Its product portfolio includes thermal imaging cores, weapon sights, handheld thermal imaging binoculars, targeting systems, missile seekers, fire-control systems, and missile-guidance systems.

According to the company, it is India's largest manufacturer of thermal imaging systems for government and defence agencies, measured by sales value. The F&amp;S Report also identifies Tonbo Imaging as India's largest exporter of thermal imaging systems, with a 94 percent share of the country's thermal imaging exports by volume.

On the financial front, Tonbo Imaging reported a net loss of Rs 17.7 crore for the quarter ended June 2026, potentially reflecting, in part, higher raw material costs and an increase in finished-goods inventories. Revenue for the quarter stood at Rs 36 crore.

The company's annual financial performance was also weaker. For the financial year ended March 2026, profit declined 30 percent to Rs 50.9 crore from Rs 72.8 crore in the previous financial year. Revenue fell 22.7 percent to Rs 362.6 crore from Rs 469.1 crore over the same period.

JM Financial and IIFL Capital Services have been appointed as the book-running lead managers for the Tonbo Imaging India IPO.

1.headline: Samara Capital, Morgan Stanley-backed Sahajanand Medical Technologies to launch 1.38-crore-share IPO on October 15
1.heading: Samara Capital, Morgan Stanley-backed Sahajanand Medical Technologies to launch 1.38-crore-share IPO on October 15
1.intro: Sahajanand Medical Technologies IPO | The company will announce the IPO price band separately on October 12.
1.body:
Mumbai-headquartered cardiovascular medical device manufacturer Sahajanand Medical Technologies (SMT), backed by Samara Capital, Morgan Stanley, and Kotak Investment Advisors, will launch its maiden initial public offering (IPO) for subscription on October 15.

The IPO comprises an offer for sale (OFS) of 1.38 crore equity shares, with no fresh issue component. The company has reserved 2.5 lakh shares for its employees.

As the IPO is entirely an OFS, the proceeds will go to the selling shareholders, and the company will not receive any funds from the public issue. The objectives of the offer are to facilitate the OFS and enable the company to realise the benefits of listing its equity shares on the stock exchanges.

Samara Capital Markets Holding, Kotak Pre-IPO Opportunities Fund, and NHPEA Sparkle Holding BV, along with the promoters, will be among the selling shareholders in the OFS.

The company will announce the IPO price band separately on October 12.

Founded by Dhirajlal Kotadia in 2001, Sahajanand Medical Technologies develops Class III and Class C/D medical devices, focusing on vascular intervention products, including coronary stents and balloons, and structural heart devices, including transcatheter aortic valve implantation (TAVI) systems and occluders. These segments contributed approximately 60 percent and 16 percent, respectively, to the company's revenue.

Click Here To Read All IPO News

The company marketed its products in 65 countries as of the quarter ended June 2026, including India and several European countries.

Samara Capital Markets Holding is the largest public shareholder in the medical device manufacturer, with a 29.61 percent stake. It is followed by Morgan Stanley affiliate NHPEA Sparkle Holding BV, with a 15.24 percent stake, and Kotak Pre-IPO Opportunities Fund, with a 5.98 percent stake. Ace investor Ashish Kacholia holds a 1.08 percent stake in the company.

Of the shares on offer, 50 percent have been reserved for qualified institutional buyers (QIBs), 15 percent for non-institutional investors (NIIs), and the remaining 35 percent for retail investors.

The one-day anchor book for institutional investors will open on October 14. The IPO will remain open for public subscription until October 19. The company is expected to finalise the share allotment by October 21, with its shares scheduled to debut on the stock exchanges on October 23.

Sahajanand Medical Technologies has reported healthy financial performance in recent periods. For the quarter ended June 2026, the company recorded a profit of Rs 15.1 crore on revenue of Rs 351.6 crore.

For the financial year ended March 2026, the company's profit rose 174.65 percent year-on-year to Rs 69.1 crore from Rs 25.15 crore in the previous financial year. Revenue increased 18.1 percent to Rs 1,210.5 crore from Rs 1,024.9 crore over the same period.

Motilal Oswal Investment Advisors, Avendus Capital, HSBC Securities and Capital Markets (India), and Nuvama Wealth Management have been appointed as merchant bankers to manage the Sahajanand Medical Technologies IPO.

2.headline: Business in the Week Ahead (October 12 – 16, 2026)
2.heading: Business in the Week Ahead (October 12 – 16, 2026)
2.intro: The upcoming week will be shaped by India’s CPI and WPI inflation data; US’ CPI inflation, industrial production output; UK’s GDP and industrial output; Eurozone area’s inflation and industrial production data
2.body:
Indian equity markets endured a volatile week, with persistent selling pressure pushing benchmark indices towards fresh lows. The benchmark index fell sharply on Thursday, slipping below the crucial 22,500 mark but on Friday, markets staged a rebound, recovering some losses as oil prices eased and buying interest returned.

However, as the Reserve Bank of India had announced a rate revision of 25 basis points and adopted a calibrated tightening stance, it has revived concerns of inflation and borrowing costs. Rising crude oil prices, elevated US bond yields and continued foreign investor outflows further weakened sentiment.

The market benchmark remains on course for a ninth consecutive weekly decline, with analysts expecting volatility and caution to persist. “Overall market sentiment remains cautiously optimistic for a recovery at the opening, although persistent FII outflows and elevated volatility continue to weigh on buying conviction,” said Hitesh Tailor, Technical Research Analyst at Choice Broking.

In IPO news, the IPO of HD Fire Protect Ltd will open for subscription on October 13 and close on October 15, 2026. The price band has been fixed at ₹258 to ₹271 per share, with a lot size of 55 shares.

Here are some important indicators that market participants should keep an eye out for.

Monday (October 12)

Earnings: HCL Tech, RBL Bank

India Inflation Rate: The headline inflation rate in India rose to 4.82% in August, from 4.45% in the previous month and aligned with market expectations of 4.8%. The September data will be shared.

Tuesday (October 13)

Earnings: ICICI Prudential Life Insurance

IPO: HD Fire Protect Ltd

Wednesday (October 14)

Earnings: BHEL, Ceat, ICICI Lombard, Tata Tech

India Wholesale Prices YoY: India’s wholesale prices increased 9.92% yoy in August, accelerating slightly from a 9.78% rise in July and surpassing expectations of 9.89%. September figures will be declared.

US Inflation Rate: The annual inflation rate in the US steadied at 3.4% in August, the same as in July and in line with forecasts. The September data will be announced.

Thursday (October 15)

Earnings: Cyient, HDFC AMC, HDFC Life, L&amp;T Finance, Karur Vysya, Nestle, Polycab, Tech Mahindra, Wipro

UK Monthly GDP YoY: The UK economy expanded 1.6% year-on-year in July, picking up from a 1.1% growth in June and beating expectations of a 1.2% expansion. The August GDP figures will be announced.

US Initial Jobless Claims: The number of Americans filing for unemployment benefits fell by 1,000 to 197,000 in the week ended September 26, below expectations of 200,000, according to the US Department of Labor. Numbers for week ending October 3 will be shared.

UK Industrial Production: Industrial Production in the United Kingdom increased 0.60 percent in July over the same month in the previous year. Data for August will be revealed.

UK Manufacturing Production: Manufacturing production in the UK increased by 2.6% year-on-year in July, above forecasts of 2% and accelerating from a 0.5% gain in the preceding period. The figures for August will be declared.

Friday (October 16)

Earnings: Bajaj Housing, CG Consumer, Federal Bank

Euro Area Inflation Rate: Eurozone annual inflation accelerated to 3.8% in September, up from 3.2% in August and above market expectations of 3.6%, according to preliminary estimates. The final data for September will be announced.

India Foreign Exchange Reserves: Foreign Exchange Reserves in India decreased to $747.56 billion in September 25 from 765.9 billion in the previous week. Numbers for week ending October 2 will be shared.

US Industrial Production: Industrial Production in the United States increased 1.40 percent in August over the same month in the previous year. Data for September will be announced.

US Manufacturing Production: Manufacturing Production in the United States increased 0.9% year-on-year in August 2026, following a 1.2% rise in July. Data for September will be declared.

Saturday (October 17)

Earnings: Axis Bank, HDFC Bank, ICICI Bank, India Cements, Yes Bank
